QUICK GUIDE

From backtest to evidence.

  1. Start in Vault

    Choose New test. Connect your signed-in RZone tab, then set your strategy, test dates and portfolio here. Choices are checked daily for this RZone connection. Use Recheck all choices after changing source rules.

  2. Run one test or try variations

    Add test values beside any setting you want to vary. Choose Review tests, then Run. Keep RZone open while Vault applies the setup, runs both backtests and saves each result automatically.

  3. Compare like with like

    Follow Set up, Run tests and Review results. Return to My studies for progress or earlier work; Compare results compares saved runs across studies. Match the period and universe.

  4. Keep an independent backup

    Back up all saves a JSON file. Import runs combines backups; matching IDs stay unchanged.

The browser viewer has its own local library. It does not connect to extension storage.
